summary: Frontend code review and bug fix for duplicate recipe images. Found 2 remaining functions using getRecipeImage instead of getUniqueRecipeImage. Applied fix. E2E testing limited due to session persistence issues in Playwright.

code_review_summary.fix_approach: The fix uses a batch-aware image selection system: resetBatchImageTracker() clears the Set at start of new batch, getUniqueRecipeImage() checks if image is already used and selects alternative from CUISINE_FALLBACK_ALTERNATIVES
functions_reviewed: getUniqueRecipeImage() - lines 369-411 - checks for duplicates and finds alternatives

action_items: Manual E2E testing recommended: Complete signup, select Happy mood, Lunch, Indian cuisine, verify recipe cards have UNIQUE images
Verify fix works for 'Moderate Option' section which was reported with duplicate images
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FOUND & FIXED: Two functions (parseRecipeFromMatch, parseRecipeContent) were still using getRecipeImage() directly instead of getUniqueRecipeImage()
This would cause duplicate images when recipes matched the same keywords (e.g., two Indian curry recipes both getting the same curry image)
All 9 imageUrl assignments now correctly use getUniqueRecipeImage()
CUISINE_FALLBACK_ALTERNATIVES has 4-6 alternative images per cuisine type, providing variety

success_rate.frontend: Code review complete, 2 bugs found and fixed, E2E partially complete due to session issues

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix applied at lines 1061 and 1225 - changed getRecipeImage to getUniqueRecipeImage. The original bug was that parseRecipeFromMatch and parseRecipeContent were bypassing the unique image system. Main agent should verify by generating recipes with Indian cuisine and checking Moderate Option section has no duplicate images.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Two parsing functions (parseRecipeFromMatch, parseRecipeContent) were using getRecipeImage() directly instead of getUniqueRecipeImage(), causing duplicate images when multiple recipes matched the same keywords
reproduction_steps: 3. Select Happy mood, Lunch, Non-Vegetarian, Indian cuisine
5. Check 'Moderate Option' section for duplicate images
